ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio; approximately 40% high-intensity white pixels localized on distal lobes versus 60% low-intensity black pixels concentrated around the median notch and inner lobe surfaces.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Distinct black contiguous masses extend from the peduncle to the mid-lobe. Distal regions (left and right) show white fields with high-frequency circular black spots (mottling). Right lobe shows a specific transition zone of medium-intensity gray pixels at the mid-inner boundary.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 55 degrees; notch depth is approximately 15% of total visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration across the entire boundary. Distal tips exhibit high-amplitude, jagged protrusions (peaks) corresponding to barnacle clusters, while the inner lobe edges show lower-frequency, smoother serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral concave sweep starting from the distal tips, transitioning to convex curves as the lobes approach the central median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast white textured clusters (barnacles) on the extreme distal tips of both lobes. Several dark, circular focal spots (rosettes) are mapped on the white ventral surface of the left distal lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (scratches) visible on the dark pigmented area of the left lobe, oriented diagonally toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy barnacle colonization on the trailing edge tips; significant linear rake marks on the interior dark pigmentation of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A unique, roughly rectangular area of gray-scale mottling is visible in the lower center of the right lobe's dark region.
